_help: Settings for aws_project.py, which finds everything a project uses across its own accounts and the shared-services accounts, and works out its ingress, egress and DNS.
shared_accounts: account numbers or profiles of the shared-services accounts. shared_words: a profile or alias containing one of these words is a shared-services account too.
eks_env_pattern: how the environment is read from an EKS cluster name (dev_ghdjegd -> dev).
keyword_limit: at most this many shared-services resources are taken per keyword (they are found by full-text search).
test_ports: ports checked for traffic into the project when a load balancer's listeners do not say; egress_ports: ports checked out to the internet.
cluster_tags: tags that tie an instance or load balancer to an EKS cluster ({cluster} is the cluster name; a tag key ending in /{cluster} works too).
